# 1.J.37.c GATING ONLY (CET_U / CET_S with IBT alone): "CPUID verified" on the VMware-guest profile cpuid_i5-13600k.txt.
# GENERATED by Emulator\tools\isa\gen_gating_cases.py --write (ledger U1630; notes\eread\G13_gating_only.md).
# Both real profiles enumerate CET_SS with the CET_U / CET_S XSAVE components (IA32_XSS bits 11 / 12), so IBT alone
# (CET_U / CET_S offered with IBT but without shadow stacks) only occurs on a synthetic profile.
#   emu-alltest --cases Emulator\data\cases_gating_guest.txt --guest --expect-only   (suite gating_cet_guest; --vm: gating_cet_vm)
# --- CPUID.(7H,0H):ECX[7] CET_SS = 1
mov eax, 0x7; mov ecx, 0; cpuid; mov r8, rcx; shr r8, 7; and r8, 1 =>! r8=1
# --- CPUID.(7H,0H):EDX[20] CET_IBT = 0
mov eax, 0x7; mov ecx, 0; cpuid; mov r8, rdx; shr r8, 20; and r8, 1 =>! r8=0
# --- CPUID.(DH,1H):ECX[11] IA32_XSS CET_U supported = 1
mov eax, 0xd; mov ecx, 1; cpuid; mov r8, rcx; shr r8, 11; and r8, 1 =>! r8=1
# --- CPUID.(DH,1H):ECX[12] IA32_XSS CET_S supported = 1
mov eax, 0xd; mov ecx, 1; cpuid; mov r8, rcx; shr r8, 12; and r8, 1 =>! r8=1
# --- CPUID.(DH,BH):ECX[0] component 11 (CET_U) is supervisor state (IA32_XSS) = 1
mov eax, 0xd; mov ecx, 11; cpuid; mov r8, rcx; shr r8, 0; and r8, 1 =>! r8=1
# --- CPUID.(DH,CH):ECX[0] component 12 (CET_S) is supervisor state (IA32_XSS) = 1
mov eax, 0xd; mov ecx, 12; cpuid; mov r8, rcx; shr r8, 0; and r8, 1 =>! r8=1
# --- CPUID.(0DH,0BH):EAX = 10H (CET_U size), CPUID.(0DH,0CH):EAX = 18H (CET_S size)
mov eax, 0xd; mov ecx, 0xb; cpuid; mov r8, rax =>! r8=0x10
mov eax, 0xd; mov ecx, 0xc; cpuid; mov r8, rax =>! r8=0x18
# --- WRMSR IA32_XSS (DA0H) = 1800H (CET_U | CET_S) is accepted and reads back
mov ecx, 0xda0; mov eax, 0x1800; xor edx, edx; wrmsr; rdmsr =>! rax=0x1800 rdx=0
